subject: Procurement kickoff: scheduling, PO path & onboarding docs
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement kickoff: scheduling, PO path & onboarding docs

Hi Leah —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Wed like to get a short kickoff on the procurement/onboarding process so we can line up: PO routing, required paperwork, SOC2 evidence, and the mutual action plan (MAP) timeline. Goal is to have a clear handoff to your procurement team and engineering so the first invoice and onboarding can proceed without surprises.

Can you confirm availability for a 30-min call next week? Options below (PT):
- Tue 10/20: 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10/21: 09:00–09:30 or 16:00–16:30

On our side Ill bring: PO instructions (what needs to be on the PO), our standard billing contact flow, and a 1-page MAP draft. Camila will cover required vendor docs and Rishi will outline expected SLAs for Dedicated capacity.

Prep asks (if you can surface before the call):
- Name/email of the person who issues POs and the billing contact
- Any internal PO/contract templates or mandatory clauses we should be aware of
- Vendor onboarding form (if you use a portal) or a PDF we should complete

Attaching our PO instructions and a blank MAP template to speed the call.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Leah Park <leah.park@acme.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-10-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: scheduling, PO path & onboarding docs

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — sounds good. Were available Tue 10/20 at 15:00 PT for 30 mins. Ill invite our procurement lead (procurement@acme.com) and the vendor onboarding coordinator.

Before the call: we can share our vendor intake form (portal) and a list of required clauses. Ill send a link to the intake form and a short checklist to fill out.

Can you include a brief agenda in your calendar invite with the MAP milestones and success criteria you mentioned? That will help our procurement lead come prepared.

-Leah
Leah Park
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Corp

[Note: forwarding procurement@acme.com on invite]

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: scheduling, PO path & onboarding docs

Thanks Leah — confirmed for Tue 10/20 15:00 PT. Ill send the invite in a minute.

Proposed 30-min agenda (please edit if you need):
1) Introductions & objectives (5 min)
2) PO flow & invoicing contact (5 min)
3) Required vendor docs and intake form walkthrough (7 min)
4) MAP milestones, owners, and success criteria (8 min)
5) Next steps & timeline for PO issuance (5 min)

Draft MAP success criteria (examples):
- PO issued to Redwood within 7 business days after contract signature
- Vendor onboarding form completed and portal access granted within 5 business days
- Test ingest / staging access for engineering within 10 business days

Attachments: Im attaching the MAP draft (filled with our suggested milestones) and a one-page vendor document checklist. Camila signature below.

Camila Reyes
Vendor Enablement Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: Vendor_Doc_Checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: procurement@acme.com
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah.park@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: scheduling, PO path & onboarding docs

Camila / Jonas —

Weve received the invite and the MAP draft. Im the procurement lead on this engagement (Procurement Team, Acme). A couple quick notes before the call:
- We require a completed vendor intake form (I will post the portal link in the calendar invite two hours before the call)
- Standard clause: our standard data processing addendum is required for any vendor processing customer data; please have the DPA link in your contract packet
- For PO: we need invoice email, remit address, and Redwoods tax ID on the PO to process within 5–7 business days after receipt

Look forward to speaking Tue 15:00 PT.

—Acme Procurement
procurement@acme.com
